note: Rewritten to schema 3 on 2026-08-28. As written by the version-2 probe this record read "outcome": "aborted", "abort_reason": "checks". The run was not aborted: k6 reported `hold ✓ [ 100% ] 120 VUs 40m0s` and the job ran 19:37:11-20:21:50Z. Version 2 derived outcome from "was any threshold crossed", and no threshold can cut a hold run short -- load_test/main.js sets abortOnFail: PHASE !== 'hold' on the two that carry it and gives checks none at all. The four fields version 2 had no place for are re-derived here rather than measured by the workflow, and their sources are named so a reader can tell them apart from the rest: duration_s 2430 from k6's own `running (40m30.0s)` line in the run log; the three cpu_credits_* readings from az monitor metrics list over 19:29-20:21Z, queried 2026-08-28, which is the window `host_facts.sh after` would have taken for a 2430-second run. Every other value is untouched and was measured by the probe at the time. Hold records after this one carry all four from the run itself.
